integrity: The divisor sign and normal bundle are derived from the actual Fan--Li torsor presentation: H_0 is the zero divisor of the tautological section of L=O(-1), and F is its scheme-theoretic pullback.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the smooth Fan--Li model for V_2^{\oplus n}; it uses standard homotopy invariance for affine bundles and does not extend their crepant-resolution classification. A residual originality risk remains for unindexed literature.
title: The exceptional divisor generates the Chow ring of the \(V_2^{\oplus n}/C_p\) resolution
